listing.name: SuperTuxKart
listing.summary: Race open-source karts with an offline profile or join multiplayer races.
listing.download_block_reason: Use the official installer, full portable package, or mobile release for your platform. The portable launchers set up the packaged game and runtime files.

steps.title: Start the official desktop package
steps.instruction: On Windows, use the installer for your architecture or extract the complete portable ZIP and run run_game.bat at its root. On Linux, extract the complete archive for your architecture, open its folder in a terminal and run ./run_game.sh. On Mac, extract the signed ZIP and open the SuperTuxKart application as a complete bundle. The 1.5 universal package contains Intel and Apple Silicon players.

steps.title: Make an offline profile
steps.instruction: Start the game and select Offline Account in the new player setup. Enter a player name and select that profile at sign-in to play without an online account. All required base game data comes with the full packages.

steps.title: Keep your profile and custom data
steps.instruction: Close SuperTuxKart and copy %APPDATA%/supertuxkart on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/SuperTuxKart on Mac, or both ~/.config/supertuxkart and ~/.local/share/supertuxkart on Linux. If you have customized the data or configuration locations, preserve those actual folders. Keep any custom files you added to the package separately.

references.title: Get the Android release
references.instruction: Use the Android store link or the official APK on the upstream Downloads page. Android handles installation and updates. Preserve your Android app data before uninstalling or switching package sources.
